'''Amita Fonti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was present at a [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] where she supported the opinions of [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] and voted aye for opening peace negotiations with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
